== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Priest of Night was a self-proclaimed figure who believed it was his responsibility to free the [[Free Worlds]] from the oversight of [[the Advocates]]. He utilized the [[Aether]] to uncover secrets and track individuals, which he used to target families for punishment. His actions included using bombs to destroy a home, an event that caused significant distress and led a wizard to rescue [[Leilari]] from the destruction. During a recorded message, he expressed a belief that pain is necessary for embracing change and claimed to have completed a specific task. His life ended abruptly when a scarred, muscular warrior-rabbit killed him by snapping his neck.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Priest of Night was a plotter whose schemes were discovered by [[Starhammer]]'s savior. This individual was involved in an attempt to destroy [[Starhammer]]'s home through a bombing.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Priest of Night was responsible for an attempted bombing that ultimately resulted in the destruction of [[Starhammer]]'s home. This individual was also linked to discussions regarding the potential redemption of [[Starhammer]], a figure who later made mention of the Priest. Although the Priest held various plans that were somehow known to [[Starhammer]]'s savior, their life ended when they were killed by a warrior-rabbit.}}
